phase_1.title: Phase 1 · CheyTac M200 Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the .408 CheyTac (10.36×77mm) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 440 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 440 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 737 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 7-groove bore and accelerates to 910 m/s (11350 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Manual Bolt Cycle & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 7-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the CheyTac M200 staged for its 10 RPM (Manual Precision Bolt) cadence.

zh.headline: 夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪：2001 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: CheyTac M200“干预”专为 1,500–2,300 米超远距精准狙击打造：车削实心铜镍合金 .408 弹头在 2,000 米外仍未跌入跨音速紊流区；管状散热护筒前置重型双脚架、中部重心提把与可拆 737 mm 凹槽枪管令 14.1 kg 巨兽高度便携。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：CheyTac M200 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2001 年问世的 夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪 由美国夏安战术公司（CheyTac USA）主导研制，定位为经典的超远程反人员/反器材狙击步枪。M200 于 2001 年由约翰·泰勒博士团队基于 Windrunner 架构演化而来，曾在爱达荷靶场创下 2,321 码（2,122 米）三发 42 cm 散步的民用远程纪录。
CheyTac M200“干预”专为 1,500–2,300 米超远距精准狙击打造：车削实心铜镍合金 .408 弹头在 2,000 米外仍未跌入跨音速紊流区；管状散热护筒前置重型双脚架、中部重心提把与可拆 737 mm 凹槽枪管令 14.1 kg 巨兽高度便携。 整件装备总长 1,346 mm（伸缩托缩回 1,187 mm）、空重 14.1 kg，成为同期狙击步枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2001 年，美国夏安战术公司（CheyTac USA）推出了划时代的夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪。M200 于 2001 年由约翰·泰勒博士团队基于 Windrunner 架构演化而来，曾在爱达荷靶场创下 2,321 码（2,122 米）三发 42 cm 散步的民用远程纪录。 它的核心设计聚焦于.408 CheyTac 实心铜镍弹头 G1 弹道系数近 0.94，超音速射程远超 .338 LM 甚至 .50 BMG，奠定了其在狙击步枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪 的机械灵魂在于其「旋转后拉式栓动 · 重型双突笋锁闭 + 伸缩折叠后托与快拆浮置凹槽枪管」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用沙色陶瓷涂层航空铝合金与氮化钢精加工而成。737 mm 重型凹槽自由浮置枪管可快速拆卸封装，全套系统含气象弹道解算终端，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪 采用旋转后拉式栓动 · 重型双突笋锁闭 + 伸缩折叠后托与快拆浮置凹槽枪管。在每个击发周期中，射手手动旋转枪机手柄使刚性闭锁突笋脱槽，向后抽抛并推进新弹入膛。借助沙色陶瓷涂层航空铝合金与氮化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了737 mm 重型凹槽自由浮置枪管可快速拆卸封装，全套系统含气象弹道解算终端。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 .408 CheyTac (10.36×77mm) 弹药规格与 737 mm 重型凹槽浮置管 · 7 条平衡飞行右旋膛线（1:330 mm），最高工作膛压约 440 MPa，可赋予弹头 910 m/s 的出膛初速与 11,350 J 动能，有效作用距离达 2300 米。
内膛技术特点方面，专利“平衡飞行弹头”与 1:330 mm 7 线精密膛线协同，使弹头跨越 2,000 m 仍保持超音速稳定。同时，重心平衡提把 + 前置一体化重型两脚架 + 后单脚架构成稳固三点精密狙击平台，令其在 10 发/分（手动长距精密闭锁） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 737 毫米身管与 .408 CheyTac (10.36×77mm) 口径，夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪 实现了每秒 910 米的初速与 2300 米有效射程。专利“平衡飞行弹头”与 1:330 mm 7 线精密膛线协同，使弹头跨越 2,000 m 仍保持超音速稳定，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 7 发容量的7 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 46 mm 膛轴设计，夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 24.5 N·s 水平。大型高效多室膛口制退器（兼可直装 OPS 消音器）大幅吸收 11.35 kJ 巨额后坐能量。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-70）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 7 发容量的7 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，大型高效多室膛口制退器（兼可直装 OPS 消音器）大幅吸收 11.35 kJ 巨额后坐能量。欢迎在 BAY-70 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 夏安 M200“干预” .408 远程狙击步枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the CheyTac M200
paragraphs: Introduced in 2001 by CheyTac USA in United States, the CheyTac M200 Intervention emerged as a defining Extreme Long-Range Sniper Rifle. Developed in 2001 around Dr. John Taylor’s Balanced Flight ballistics research, the M200 famously printed a three-shot 16.6-inch group at 2,321 yards (2,122 m) in Idaho.

Built for extreme-range precision between 1,500 and 2,300 meters, the CheyTac M200 Intervention launches lathe-turned solid .408 projectiles that stay supersonic past 2,000 m from a quick-change fluted barrel, tubular bipod shroud, and sliding rail stock. Measuring 1,346 mm (1,187 mm Stock Collapsed) at an unloaded weight of 14.1 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Sniper Rifle class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2001, CheyTac USA of United States introduced the CheyTac M200 Intervention. Developed in 2001 around Dr. John Taylor’s Balanced Flight ballistics research, the M200 famously printed a three-shot 16.6-inch group at 2,321 yards (2,122 m) in Idaho. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Lathe-turned .408 CheyTac solids achieve ~0.94 G1 BC, staying supersonic beyond 2,000 meters — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the CheyTac M200 Intervention sits its Turn-Bolt Action · Heavy Dual-Lug Lockup, Collapsing Rail Stock & Quick-Change Fluted Barrel. Throughout every firing cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering, containing 440 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in Flat Dark Earth Cerakote 7075 aluminum and nitrided steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 737 mm fluted free-floating barrel detaches rapidly for compact transit cases, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The CheyTac M200 Intervention relies on Turn-Bolt Action · Heavy Dual-Lug Lockup, Collapsing Rail Stock & Quick-Change Fluted Barrel. During each cycle, manual bolt rotation disengages rigid locking lugs before rearward extraction and forward chambering. Machined from Flat Dark Earth Cerakote 7075 aluminum and nitrided steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 737 mm fluted free-floating barrel detaches rapidly for compact transit cases.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for .408 CheyTac (10.36×77mm) with 737 mm Heavy Fluted Free-Float · 7-Groove Balanced-Flight RH (1:330 mm), the CheyTac M200 Intervention develops 910 m/s muzzle velocity and 11,350 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 2300 meters.

Internally, Matched to lathe-turned Balanced Flight copper-nickel solids to maintain supersonic stability past 2,000 meters. Combined with its 10 RPM (Manual Precision Bolt) tempo, Center-of-balance carry handle, integral forward bipod, and rear monopod form a rock-solid chassis, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving .408 CheyTac (10.36×77mm) through its 737 millimeter bore, the CheyTac M200 Intervention achieves 910 meters per second and 2300 meters of effective reach. Matched to lathe-turned Balanced Flight copper-nickel solids to maintain supersonic stability past 2,000 meters.
